message: around <ng-container>, which name(s) nothing of their own
$reason: `group-around-containers-a-directive-stops-on` with an `<NG-CONTAINER>` written as a stop instead: an element of the DOM, which the compiler draws with its `tabindex` (`ɵɵdomElement`, measured with `ngc` 22.2.1), so the group holds a control that names nothing of its own. A reader that lowered the name before asking whether the tag was Angular's own read no stop on it, and refused the group for holding no control.
